title: Designed assets at init
asked: Backfilled from CLAUDE.md Status (built before builds reported themselves).

result.summary: `init` takes `assets: [asset@1 …]` (`checkDesignedAssets`: validated like framework assets, own ids only — a framework starter's id is refused —, ≤ 40, ≤ 200 KB each) written into the new app's assets folder, and `slots` may pick them (`checkSlotPicks(slots, template, designed)`); engine-rpc/console
